rv.q: One is made of giant military maps; the other, of billowing piles of regimental laundry that Marie — the adopted mascot and the title’s “daughter of the regiment” — must conquer. A third summit looms, unseen, in the music: the aria “ Ah! mes amis ,” sung by Tonio, the Tyrolean mountain boy who upends Marie’s world.
In all, this was a triumph and the true return of Bel Canto at the Metropolitan Opera.
And this revival conveyed it with aplomb—a decisive victory, to be sure.
His voice was consistent in tone throughout and well supported, making a pleasing and characterful performance.

cn.t: Critics praise this winning Met Opera revival of Donizetti's bel canto gem, celebrating Erin Morley and Lawrence Brownlee's virtuosic singing and sparkling coloratura in Laurent Pelly's charming production.
